subject.title: fix(tls): add subjectAltName to auto-generated gateway self-signed certificate (fixes #96910)

question: Should this PR include a user-reachable doctor or migration repair for existing OpenClaw-generated CN-only gateway certs before it closes the linked gateway TLS issue, and is the proposed default SAN set acceptable?
rationale: The code changes gateway TLS certificate identity and exposes a cert-rotation helper, while the current branch does not decide or implement the permanent upgrade path for existing generated certs.

options.title: Require doctor-backed repair before merge
options.body: Wire the CN-only default-cert repair into an explicit doctor or migration path with tests and current-head proof before this PR closes the linked issue.

options.title: Merge fresh-cert-only scope
options.body: Accept the generator change for new certs only and keep the existing-cert repair as separate tracked work with the PR body updated accordingly.

options.title: Pause for TLS policy review
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers/security revise or approve the SAN inventory and certificate-repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Require doctor-backed repair before merge
recommendation.body: Wire the CN-only default-cert repair into an explicit doctor or migration path with tests and current-head proof before this PR closes the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The shipped gateway TLS module traces to vincentkoc's release commit, and prior discussion already asked this handle to review the TLS identity boundary.
